stops.name: Röthbach Waterfall
stops.quote: At 470 metres, the Röthbach Waterfall in Berchtesgaden National Park is Germany’s highest.
stops.english: At 470 metres, the Röthbach Waterfall in Berchtesgaden National Park is Germany’s highest.

stops.name: Berchtesgaden National Park
stops.quote: Röthbach Waterfall in Berchtesgaden National Park plunges over a height of 470 metres, cascading down the rock and overcoming two large steps.
stops.english: Röthbach Waterfall in Berchtesgaden National Park plunges over a height of 470 metres, cascading down the rock and overcoming two large steps.

stops.name: Königssee Lake
stops.quote: The mighty rock barrier, up to 700 metres high, separates the basin of Königsee Lake from the Röth, a plateau that stretches between the Steinernes Meer and the Hagengebirge mountains.
stops.english: The mighty rock barrier, up to 700 metres high, separates the basin of Königsee Lake from the Röth, a plateau that stretches between the Steinernes Meer and the Hagengebirge mountains.

stops.name: Röth
stops.quote: The mighty rock barrier, up to 700 metres high, separates the basin of Königsee Lake from the Röth, a plateau that stretches between the Steinernes Meer and the Hagengebirge mountains.

stops.name: Saletalm
stops.quote: You can reach Röthbach Waterfall by taking a boat trip across Königssee Lake to the Saletalm exit.
stops.english: You can reach Röthbach Waterfall by taking a boat trip across Königssee Lake to the Saletalm exit.

stops.name: Obersee Lake
stops.quote: Afterwards, you can hike along the small Obersee Lake to the Fischunkelalm pasture in about an hour.
stops.english: Afterwards, you can hike along the small Obersee Lake to the Fischunkelalm pasture in about an hour.

stops.name: Landtal Waterfall
stops.quote: A little to the north, another impressive cascade spills down into the depths: the 410-metre Landtal Waterfall, the second highest waterfall in Germany.
stops.english: A little to the north, another impressive cascade spills down into the depths: the 410-metre Landtal Waterfall, the second highest waterfall in Germany.
